title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-12-02
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a mellow 12/2/73 show with a standout second‑set sequence; crisp audio despite minor pitch quirks.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the relaxed vibe and superb second‑set flow, highlighting a killer Dire Wolf, an explosive Wharf Rat → Mississippi Uptown → Playing → Mind Left Body → He's Gone → Truckin' sequence and a soaring Morning Dew. The Dick’s #14 soundboard source is generally clear, though it runs slightly low in pitch and shows occasional out‑of‑tune guitars.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed reviews give high marks to the musical performance (especially the second set) and note good but not perfect soundboard quality, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Dick's #14 source provides clear, updated sonic picture; however the tape runs about –1.5 % pitch and there are occasional out‑of‑tune guitars in the first set.

standout_songs: Wharf Rat > Mississippi Uptown > Playing > Mind Left Body > He's Gone > Truckin'
poor_songs: Beat It On Down the Line (slow tempo)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A mellow, rain‑and‑snow opening first set that drifts slowly, followed by a high‑energy second set with seamless segues and several frisson‑filled jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Depth in his lyrics praised; his guitar ‘catches fire’ on Brown-Eyed Women, though he strains on some high notes. Floats New Speedway but doesn’t fully land it later.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as great overall; early first‑set vocals sound off, but Bobby shines on Big River and Wharf Rat.
band_member_comments.Keys: Piano noted as beautiful, adding to the mellow feel of the show.
